name: skills
one_liner: A library of pre-built instruction packets that teach Claude how to do specific jobs (write a Word doc, fill a PDF, follow a brand guide) instead of guessing each time.
buyer: An AI consultant or small agency that builds custom Claude workflows for non-technical clients and wants proven starting points instead of writing instructions from scratch.
business_use_cases: A consultant studies the document-generation skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) to understand the pattern, then writes a custom 'generate branded client reports' skill for an accounting firm.
An agency runs a paid workshop teaching marketing teams to write their own brand-voice skill so every AI-written post matches company style automatically.
A SaaS company forks the open-source document skills to add 'export to Word/PDF/PowerPoint' into its own AI product instead of building that from zero.

money_ideas.idea: Paid 'custom skill' build service for businesses that want Claude to follow their exact process
A skill-writing workshop or course for non-engineers

steal_this: Pick one repetitive task a client does by hand (formatting a weekly report), write a 10-minute skill for it using the template folder here, and demo it as a paid add-on.
